zh: message digest：散列算法对消息算出的输出，本文件中长 160 至 512 比特。
secure hash algorithm：本文件指定的七个算法的统称。
one-way hash function：由消息到摘要可算、由摘要反求消息不可行的函数。
preprocessing：哈希计算前的两步处理，含消息填充、分组解析与初始值设定。
truncated message digest：对较长摘要取左端若干比特得到的缩短结果。
en: Message digest: the output of a hash algorithm over a message, 160 to 512 bits in this Standard.
Secure hash algorithm: the collective name for the seven algorithms specified here.
SHA-2 family: SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, SHA-512/224 and SHA-512/256.
One-way hash function: computable from message to digest, infeasible to invert from digest to message.
Preprocessing: the steps before hash computation, covering padding, block parsing and the initial value.
Truncated message digest: the shortened result formed by taking leftmost bits of a longer digest.
